caseNameFull: Warner, doing business as Warner & Tamble Transportation Co. v. United States
attorneys: James W. Wrape and Glenn M. Elliott for appellants. Solicitor General Perlman and Daniel W. Knowlton for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission; and Harry C. Ames for the American Barge Line Co. et al., appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Western District of Tennessee. Per Curiam: The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.
